༄༅// bstan srung dbang po rnams thugs dgyes par bskyed pa dang dgra bgegs la rbad pa'i tshul du sgrub pa'i phrin las gtor bzlog g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i ngar zhes bya ba bzhugs// shes byar dpyod pa'i 'dren byed stong bgrad pas// bcud bral mel tsher rgyu ba'i dogs pa skyungs// skal bzang kun dga'i dpal bskyed 'khor lo yi// mgon po rdo rje 'chang de gtsug tu mchod// rnam thar brgyad ldan zhal dar stong pa nyid// bcu drug lag pas 'gro ba'i bro brgyad len// dbang phyug brgyad ster bsdu bzhi'i gar gyis rtsan// brtan g.yo'i khyab bdag he ru ka dpal bdud// rgyal ba'i dgongs 'grel smra mchog sa skya par// rdo rje gur mgon gyis mtshon bstan srung tshogs// sgrub tshul gdams pa rin chen 'byung gnas bzhin// zab yangs bzhugs pa'i gting mtha' dpag tu ci// de tshul snang byed kun mkhyen e waṃ pa'i// zhal lung man ngag g.yul las rnam rgyal bas// dngos bstan dgyes par bskyed dang dgra bgegs la// rbad tshul gtor ma'i phrin las rnam gsal bgyi// bka' srung tshogs la bstan 'gror sdang ba'i dgra// snying rje'i yul phyir bzod par smreng sems kyang*// las ngan gsog tshul dran pas da ltar nyid// tshar gcod las su bskul ba'i tshul 'di thal// de'ang kun gzigs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag dpal sa skya pa yab sras rnams la bstan srung dbang po rnams kyi sgrub tshul gyi gdams pa rgya mtsho lta bur bzhugs pa las/ 'dir bstan srung thugs mnyes pa'i tshul du sgrub pa dang*/ dgra bgegs la rbad pa'i tshul du sgrub pa gnyis su gsungs pa ji ltar nyams su len pa la gsum ste/ sbyor ba dang*/ dngos gzhi dang*/ rjes so// dang po la/ gnas khang rgyan gyis brgyan pa la yi dam dang chos skyong gi rten dgram pa'i mdun du/ stegs kyi khar yi dam chos skyong rnams kyi gtor ma lnga tshar dang*/

bskang gtor dang*/ mchod pa nyer spyod dang*/ bskang rdzas spyan gzigs ci 'byor pa rnams spyi ltar bsham/ nyi ma rjes ma dang 'brel ba'i tshe/ de dag gi mdun phyogs la sogs par dmar gtor sha khrag gis brgyan pa bzhi la/ khrag gi ar+ghaṃ la sogs pa drag po'i mchod pa gtor ma'i 'go phyogs dang ldog par 'greng tshar du bkod pa/ bsgral rgyu'i liṅga zan dang rdzas ngan gyis sbags pa lcags snod du bzhag pa khebs ldan dang*/ gnyis ka ltar yang thun gtor dang bskang rdzas spyan gzigs zhi drag gi chas ci 'byor pa rnams bsham mo// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la gnyis kyi/ dang por thugs mnyes pa'i tshul du sgrub pa la/ gnas khang mchod pa byin gyis brlabs// bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon 'gro bas// mdun bskyed gtor mas mnyes par byed// sngags bzlas bshags pas mnyes par byed// thugs dam bskang bas mnyes par byed// bstod dbyangs bstab pas mnyes par byed// ces pa ltar te/ de dag ni rje ngor chen yab sras kyi yig cha las ji ltar 'byung ba ltar gtor bsngo bskang gso bstod pa'i bar grub pa bya'o// gnyis pa dgra bgegs la rbad pa'i tshul du sgrub pa la/ dgra bgegs dgug bstim ched du rbad// bzlas pas thugs rgyud bskul zhing rbad// bsgral mchod stob pas bskul te rbad// 'gal rkyen bzlog par bcol zhing rbad// zor 'phen las la bskul te rbad// ces pa ltar lnga las/ dang po la thugs mnyes pa'i tshul du sgrub pa rnams bstod pa bcas sngon du btang nas/ dngos gzhir sngar gyi liṅga slob dpon gyi mdun du bzhag pa khebs bsal te/ rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod 'thor ba dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las khaṃ nag po las gnam lcags las grub pa'i gshin rje'i khang sgrom nag po gru gsum pa/ kha dog cing gting zab pa/ nang du dug nad mtshon cha'i bu yug rab tu 'tshubs pa/

rmongs byed/ rengs byed/ rmugs byed kyi mun pa nag po 'khrigs shing zin nas thar sa med pa/ de'i nang du nṛ las dgra bgegs thams cad kyi ngo bo/ dam nyams byad ma'i gzugs brnyan lus rid pa/ skra 'dzings pa/ lus la shu ba dang phol mig gis btab pa/ yan lag lcags sgrog tu chud pa/ sdug bsngal zhing nyam thag pa/ gcer bu 'dar si le ba'i rnam pa can du gyur ces brjod cing bsams la/ bdag nyid yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi mgon po 'khor bcas la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ de dag khro 'khrugs rngams pa'i nyams kyis/ sku las rang 'dra'i sprul pa/ yang sprul/ pho nya las mkhan mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa stong gsum 'jig rten khyab par skad cig gcig la spros/ de rnams kyis gnod byed dgra bgegs gang na gnas pa nas dgug gzhug bcing dang dbang du byed par bsams la/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje dril bu dang bcas pa'i hūm̐ mdzad kyi phyag rgya bcas te/ thams cad kyi ngag tu/ dzaḥrje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das snying po kye rdo rje la sogs pa'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dpal rdo rje nag mo chen po gur gyi mgon po/ yum chen e ka dzā ṭi/ lha mo 'dod khams dbang mo/ dam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ bka' sdod pu tra ming sring*/ las byed ru 'dren sde zhi/ rnam 'phrul gaṇ+ḍi'i dmag tshogs/ sprul pa yang sprul tshogs dang bcas pa'i bka' bden pa dang*/ zhing skyong dbang phyug gzi ldan/ yum chen sring mo rnam bzhi/ zhing skyong pho mo 'bum sde/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad la sogs pa dpal mgon chos skyong ba'i srung ma ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang*/

chos dbyings rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing*/ chos can rgyu 'bras bslu ba med pa'i bden pa dang bden pa chen po'i byin gyis brlabs kyis/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bshig pa/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang dmod pa/ bla ma dam pa'i sku dgra/ dge 'dun gyi spyi dgra/ sems can yongs la 'tshe ba/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la tho 'tshams shing chos sgrub pa'i gegs byed pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma gnod byed thams cad skad cig thang gcig yung tsam la dgra bgegs kyi gzugs brnyan 'di la khug cig phob cig sarba bigh+nān sha trūṃ ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes dang*/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ā be sha ya hoḥ zhes dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ yang yang brjod pas bstim/ de lta bu lan gsum bya/ slar yang lha dbye'i ched du/ rje btsun rtsa ba sogs nas/ dam nyams dgra bgegs byad ma gnod byed thams cad srung bar byed pa'i lha dang phyes shig skyob par byed pa'i lha dang phyes shig de bzhin du pho lha dang*/ mo lha dang*/ zhang lha dang*/ dgra lha dang*/ srog lha dang*/ yul lha dang*/ srung 'khor gyi lha dang*/ yi dam gyi lha dang*/ chos skyong srung ma thams cad dang phyes shig ces dang*/ mgon po dang lha mo dang*/ zhal bzhi pa rnams kyi sngags thung rnams dang*/ las mgon pho mo'i bod pa rnams kyi mthar/ sarba de bāḥpra bhe da ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces btags pa brjod/ slar yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu spros pas/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi mthu dang nus pa thams cad oṃ dkar po/ āḥdamar po/ hūm̐ sngon po'i rnam par tshur bkug ste rang gi gnas gsum du bstims pas/ rang gi sgo gsum gyi nus mthu dang gzi brjid rab tu rgyas par rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur par bsam mo// gnyis pa ni/ rang yi dam du brtan par bsgoms nas/

de wa pi tsu cung zad bzlas pas gnya' mnan la/ bstan srung rnams kyi sngags bzla ba'i tshe/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub pa dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ mdun gyi mgon po 'khor bcas la phog pas thugs rgyud bskul/ de dag gi ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas/ rang 'dra'i las byed kyi mgon po nag po drag gtum gri gug thod pa la sogs pa phyag mtshan sna tshogs thogs pa 'jig rten gyi khams khyab par spros te/ de rnams kyis bstan pa dang rnal 'byor pa la sdang ba'i gnod byed dgra bgegs gang na gnas pa nas bzung ste yan lag bcing*/ brdeg cing bsdigs bzhin pas bkug ste/ mdun gyi liṅga la bstim zhing*/ las kyi mgon po rnams kyis yan lag bcings/ tshe dang bsod nams phrogs/ stobs nyams par byas/ snying dral/ tho bas brdungs/ mtshon cha sna tshogs ser char drag po ltar phab ste/ lus dum bur byas par bsams la/ shā sa na sham bu can dang mgon po dang lha mo dang zhal bzhi pa'i sngags rnams kyi mjug tu dgra bgegs che ge mo thams cad mā ra ya phaṭa ces btags pa dang*/ las mgon mo'i bod pa ni/ oṃ ro ru ro ru tri tsa pa la a shug+me ma hūm̐ ma bh+yo dzaḥdzaḥrbad pa ni/ traka rak+sha kha mun+t+ra ru lu ru lu traka rak+sha snying khrag snying bh+yo/ pu tra pu tra bh+yo/ sha sha traka sha sha traka traka mo traka gnod byed sha trūṃ mā ra ya/ bsad pa ni/ ma hā rak+sha tsit+ta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ ka ma la rak+sha tsit+ta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ gu h+ya rak+sha tsit+ta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ tri baṃ rak+sha tsit+ta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ ma ma tsa phur tsit+ta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ pu ru tsa lum tsit+ta srog tuṃ tuṃ/ gnod byed sha trūṃ bigh+nān mā ra ya/ pho'i bod pa ni/ a li a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ shaṃ shaṃ li shi ded/ a sho ded/ rmo rmugs pu tri a li ma dzaḥdzaḥ nag mo sha la rub dzaḥdzaḥrbad pa ni/ dh+ri ka dh+ri ka ya du pa sha ni sod/ dum shig a gats+tsha a gats+tsha/ ya nṛ ya nṛ/ mon bu dzaḥ

mon bu khrag la 'jib dzaḥbasad pa ni/ nṛ na rbad/ du na rbad/ shi na rbad/ shag shig rbad/ tri na rbad/ du na rbad/ mon pu pu tra shaṃ rbad/ yaṃ rmugs/ ling 'dus/ khaṃ shod pa ya mo dzaḥ dgra bo'i rus la khrol khrol/ gser gyi spu gri gnod byed dgra bgegs kyi srog la ya rbad mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa rnams rkan sgra dang bcas te drag tu bzlas/ mi shes na bod sngags sham bu btags pa ci nus bzlas mthar/ slob dpon gyis gnam lcags kyi phur bu blangs la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las phur bu sku stod gsod byed las kyi mgon po sku mdog mthing nag rab tu khros pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ lte ba man chad gnam lcags zhun ma las grub pa lta bu zur gsum pa/ rno dbal dang ldan pa me'i tsha tsha 'phro ba/ gang la bsnun pa thogs med du 'bigs pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur par bsams la/ hūm̐ khros pa'i gzugs ldan gdug pa gang*// ji ltar rgyal bas mi 'dul ba// gdul ba'i dam bcas dgongs mdzod la// da lta nyid du 'dir khug cig /'bar ba gshin rje'i khung bu ru// rab tu bcings nas mnar ba yi// gzugs kyi snying gar phur bu che// nag po chen po phyag gnyis pa// gnam lcags 'bar ba'i zur gsum dbal// rab tu bsnan no mnar ba'i sems// rnam pa ma rig bral gyur nas// nag po chen pos rjes su zung*// ces dang*/ shā sa na dang*/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān sha trūṃ mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces mang du brjod kyin phur bu snying gar bsgril zhing btab pas tshe'i rgyun bcad/ sems kyi rten dang bral ste/ dgra bo'i rnam par shes pa hūm̐ yig gi rnam par gnas pa de la/ hūm̐ rnam par mi rtog chos kyi dbyings// lus ngan 'di la ma zhugs shig /ces yid kyis brjod pas phur pa'i khong seng nas 'thon te mdun gyi nam mkhar gnas pa la/

oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs lngas mchod la/ slar yang rgya mthongs nas bya 'phur ba bzhin du skad cig gcig la mi bskyod pa'i zhing du gshegs par bsams la phaṭa drag por brjod cing*/ mig gyen du lta ba dang bcas te bsgral bya'i sems dang*/ sgrol byed kyi thabs/ bsgral ba po rang sems gsum so sor dbyer mi phyed par ro gcig tu bsres nas/ 'dzin med blo 'das kyi ngang du ci gnas su mnyam par 'jog go /slar yang rnam smin gyi lus de bstan srung rnams kyis mtshon cha dang dug nad kyi char phab ste khrol tshag ltar 'bigs par bsams la/ shā sa na'i sngags bzla zhing thun rdzas rnams kyis brab ste/ mthar gri gug gis kyang dum bur gtub cing bsgral/ gzhan rnams kyis de'i bar la rol mo'i sgra drag po rgyun ring ba bya'o// gsum pa ni/ gtor ma'i mdun gyi drag po'i nyer spyod rnams dang*/ gsol ka'i phyir/ gtor snod rnams su ling ro dang sha dum gsum tshan gsum ste dgu'am gsum skabs su gang babs dang*/ khrag chab gnyis dang*/ chu gtsang gi chab bcas bshams la/ mchod rdzas rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi dgra bgegs rnams bkug cing bsgral ba las byung ba'i sha khrag rus gsum gyi gtor ma ri dang rgya mtshor mnyam pa khrag gi ar+ghaṃ/ dbang po lnga'i me tog tshil chen gyi bdug spos/ zhun chen gyi mar me/ mkhris pa'i dri chab/ sha rus kyi zhal zas/ dung chen gyi gling bu sogs rol mo'i bye brag dang*/ gzhan yang g.yang gzhi'i bla re/ rgyu rlon gyi lda ldi/ rus pa'i rgyan rnam pa drug la sogs pa mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dpal rdo rje nag po chen po la sogs pa dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs mnyes par byed pa'i dam rdzas mchod sprin bsams gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur par bsams la/

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐/ oṃ sarba bit+pū ra pū ra su ra su ra a war+t+ta ya a war+t+ta ya hoḥbadz+ra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab bo// de nas/ hūm̐ dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi// rak+ta'i rgya mtsho rab bskyil bar// lbu ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa yi// ar+ghaṃ mchog gi mchod pa 'di// dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi dpal mgon 'khor bcas 'bul// dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā li de w+yai ma hā kā la tsa turmu khā ya/ sarba karma nā the bh+yaḥs pa ri wā ra ma hā rak+ta sa mu dra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi mig dang ni// rna ba dang ni de bzhin sna// lce dang tsit+ta yang dag ldan// dbang po lnga yi me tog 'di// dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi dpal mgon 'khor bcas 'bul// dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// sngags thog mtha' gnyis 'dra bar kun la sbyar/ ma hā pañca in+d+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi tshil chen po// bdud rtsi lnga dang yang dag ldan// byin za chen pos bsregs pa yis// bdug pa'i sprin gyi mchod pa 'di// dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi dpal mgon 'khor bcas 'bul// dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// ma hā me da dhū pe/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi sbrang chen po// spra ba ras kyi sdong bu btsugs// yi dwags me yis sbar ba yi// snang gsal mchog gi mchod pa 'di// dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi dpal mgon 'khor bcas 'bul// dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// ma hā madz+dza ā lo ke dgra bgegs rnams kyi mkhris pa zhag /bdud rtsi lnga dang yang dag sbags// nus pa mchog dang rab ldan pa// rab tu sbyar ba'i dri mchog 'di// dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi dpal mgon 'khor bcas 'bul// dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// ma hā bit+ta ba sā gan+dhe/

dgra bgegs rnams kyi sha rus kyi// bza' ba khrag gi btung bar ldan// ri dang rgya mtshor mnyam pa yis// ro brgya ldan pa'i mchod pa 'di// dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral dang*// 'dod khams dpal mgon 'khor bcas 'bul// dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// ma hā māṃ sa as+thi ru dhi ra bhuñjā tha pi pa tha āḥhūm̐/ dril bu dam tshig bskul ba'i sgra// rnga chen kun nas brjid pa'i sgra// dung chen gling bu snyan pa'i sgra// cang te'u phrin las bskul ba'i sgra// gsang ba'i rnga chung dbang sdud sgra// sna tshogs rol mo mchod pa'i sgra// 'jigs byed chen po mnyes byed pa'i// rab brjid snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs 'di// dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi dpal mgon 'khor bcas 'bul// dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// dzī shwa pā d+yaṃ shab+da pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ g.yang gzhi'i bla bre nam mkha'i rgyan// rgyu rlon lda ldi bar snang rgyan// keng rus phreng ba sa gzhi'i rgyan// phyag rgya rnam drug sku yi rgyan// 'jigs byed chen po mnyes byed pa'i// bla na med pa'i mchod pa 'di// dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi dpal mgon 'khor bcas 'bul// dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// ma hā a laṃ kṛ ta pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ myos byed stong gi bcud bsdus pa'i// lcags kyu lnga dang yang dag ldan// bdud rtsi lnga dang rab sbyar te// ye shes lnga yis byin brlabs pa'i// kha dog dri ro nus par ldan// dngos grub pad+mo 'byung ba'i gnas// mkha' 'gro ngang pa 'du ba'i gzhi// gsang ba bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho 'di// dpal ldan mgon po lcam dral dang*// gdong bzhi dpal mgon 'khor bcas 'bul// dam tshig dbang gis bzhes nas kyang*// bcol ba'i phrin las grub par mdzod// dz+nyā na a mṛ ta sa mu dra pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/

dgra bgegs rnams kyi sha dang khrag /sgron me lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga// bza' dang btung ba sna tshogs bcas// sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes byas pa// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya yis// bzhed dgu 'byung ba'i rgya mtshor ni// mngon par byin gyis brlabs nas kyang*// dam tshig bzhin du bdag 'bul gyis// thugs dam bzhin du bzhes mdzod la// dam bcas bzhin du rjes dgongs nas// rnal 'byor bdag gis bcol ba yi// las rnams thams cad grub par mdzod// oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā ya/ ma hā kā li de w+yai/ ma hā kā la tsa tur mu khā ya/ sarba karma nā the bh+yaḥs pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba liṃ ta pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang*/ slar yang gtor ma rnams/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya shā sa na sogs lan gsum dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā li de w+yai sogs kyis mgon po lcam dral dang*/ oṃ ma hā kā la kā la bi kā la sogs kyis dpal mgon dang*/ a li a li ma sogs kyis las mgon rnams dang*/ oṃ ghṛ rā dza sogs kyis dur khrod bdag po dang gtor ma de nyid la dmigs/ gzhan las kyi gshin rje la sogs pa khyad par gyi bka' sdod 'bul dgos yod pa rnams la mkha' 'gro spyi gtor la dmigs nas/ so so'i gtor sngags btags pa lan gsum re brjod pas 'bul/ oṃ sarba dhar+m+ma pā la sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ.oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ sngags de la 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod phul la/ hūm̐ phan bde'i bstan pa skyong mdzad cing*// log 'dren 'dul mdzad bstan pa la// rab zhugs thams cad bu bzhin du// skyong mdzad srung ma'i tshogs la 'dud// ces pas bstod do// de nas gsol kha stob pa ni/ las kyi rdo rje zhig gis sngar gyi ling ro sum tshan gsum bran te/ gsol kha tshar re la de 'dra lan gsum re gtor chen so sor bstab cing*/ g.yas g.yon khrag chang thigs re'ang blugs te 'bul ba'i thog mar/ ling ro dang sha dum rnams bsang sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las dgra bgegs kyi sha'i ri bo/ khrag gi rgya mtsho/ rus pa'i gram khrod chen pos stong gsum khyab par gyur par bsam/ de rnams mgon po 'khor bcas kyi zhal rab tu gdangs pa'i nang du bstabs pa/ hab thob tu bzhes nas zag med kyi bde bas mnyes te/ srid pa gsum na 'gran zla med pa'i sku nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur par bsam zhing*/ hoḥdapal ldan mgon po nag po/ sa bcu'i dbang phyug chen po/ rgyal ba'i bka' srung dam pa/ lha srung yongs kyi sde dpon/ dur khrod kun gyi bdag po/ rig 'dzin yongs kyi srog shing*/ rnal 'byor kun gyi dgra lha/ bstan pa yongs kyi bya ra ba/ dug gsum nad kyi sman pa/ bdud 'dul rnams kyi dpa' bo/ ma hā de wa'i sras po/ lha chen dpal 'bar 'jigs byed chen po/ dam nyams kun gyi srog gcod/ mna' zan kun gyi gshed ma 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ dpal ldan lha mo nag mo/ 'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ dur khrod kyi bdag mo/ gshin rje'i lcam mo// bdud kyi yum chen/ nad do cog gi bdag mo/ bdud rtsi sman gyi rgyal mo/ ma mo mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi zhal du gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes dang*/ mgon po'i gtor sngags shā sa na dang lha mo'i gtor sngags brjod cing*/ rol chen dang bcas pas mgon po lcam dral gyi gtor mar dang po bstab/ de bzhin du hoḥdapal ldan nag po chen po/ gdong bzhi gnyan gyi mgon po/ gtsug lag khang gi srung ma/ dug gsum nad kyi sman pa/ rig 'dzin rnams kyi srog shing*/ rnal 'byor rnams kyi dgra lha/ bdud 'dul sngags kyi dbang phyug bstan pa srung bar khas blangs pa'i yum las kyi gnod sbyin ma chen mo bzhi la sogs te/ bstan pa bsrung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i srung ma rnams kyi zhal du gnod byed dgra bgegs thams cad kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes dang zhal gyi gtor sngags brjod cing zhal bzhi pa'i gtor mar bstab/

slar yang*/ hoḥdam can gnod sbyin yab yum/ bka' sdod pu tra ming sring*/ sprul pa ru 'dren sde bzhi/ dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud/ dur khrod bdag po yab yum/ snang srid lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes dang*/ las mgon dang dur khrod rnams kyi gtor sngags brjod la las mgon gyi gtor mar gsol kha bstabs nas/ thams cad thun mong du phrin las su bsgo ba ni/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥdapal ldan ma hā kā la khrag 'thung gi rgyal po/ ye shes gsal ba'i spyan dang ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul myur ba'i zhabs dang ldan pa/ nag po stong gi 'khor dang ldan pa/ sha za 'bum gyi 'khor dang ldan pa/ ma mo bye ba'i 'khor dang ldan pa/ dam nyams kun gyi srog gcod/ rig 'dzin kun gyi srog shing*/ gtsug lag khang gi srung ma/ dug gsum nad kyi sman pa 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang nas/ sa skya pa chen po yab sras brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ bstan 'dzin gyi sku tshe srings/ dge 'dun gyi sde spel/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi nad dang gdon dang nye bar 'tshe ba dang mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzod cig tshe dang bsod nams 'khor dang longs spyod phun sum tshogs pa thams cad rgyas par mdzod cig rgyal po yul 'khor grong khyer pa rnams dang 'byung po thams cad dbang du mdzod cig gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams kyi bsam pa thams cad rengs pa dang rmugs par mdzod cig bstan pa rin po che la gnod cing dam tshig rnam par dral bar gyur pa'i las ngan pa dpag med gsog pa'i gnod byed 'di rnams yul phyogs gzhan du bskrad par mdzod cig gnyen bshes kun dang phye bar mdzod cig mdza' bo kun dang bral bar mdzod cig

rnal 'byor bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod cig ces dang rol chen bya'o// de ltar gsol kha dang po gsum song nas/ slar yang de 'dra ba tshang ma tshar gnyis te/ tshar gsum bya'o// bzhi pa ni/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer tsha zhing rtsub par 'phros/ bstan srung dbang po 'khor bcas la 'gal rkyen bar chad bzlog pa'i las la bskul bas/ de dag khro 'khrugs rngam pa'i nyams kyi rang 'dra'i sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul gyi tshogs stong gsum khyab par spros/ bdag cag yon mchod la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i mi dang mi ma yin pa'i bsam sbyor ngan pa brtsams pa'i mthu dang nus pa/ ltas ngan pa'i rigs dang chags che nyam nga sogs bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad bkug ste/ mtshon cha sna tshogs pas gtubs/ ye shes kyi me dpung gi tshogs kyis bsregs/ shangs nas bus pa'i rlung chen dus mtha'i 'thor rlung lta bus rjes med du gtor/ bh+yo bh+yo bzlog bzlog gi sgra drag po 'brug stong ldir ba lta bus stong gsum g.yo bar nus pa'i rang bzhin du bsgrags pa'i sgo nas bzlog pa'i las mdzad par bsams la/ hūm̐ lha chen dpal 'bar sogs nas/ hūm̐ bh+yoḥdapal 'bar ma hā kā la mthu ma chung*// zhes sogs bzlog bskul ci rigs par bya'o// de dag gis dngos gzhi'i bzlog bskul yan chad rnams grub nas/ nyin gnyis sam gsum sogs sbrel nas byed na/ skabs 'dir rdo rje'i glu bkra shis smon lam dang*/ spyi stabs kyi thun gtor 'bul ba/ 'dod don dngos grub zhus la/ yi ge brgya pa dang bzod par gsol ba sogs spyi ltar bya'o// sang nyin lta bu nyi ma rjes ma la/ bdag mdun sgrub pa nas bzlog bskul bcas gong bzhin byed pa yin no// lnga pa ni/ gtor chen rnams sgrub khang gi nang gi sa gzhir gcan gzan gdug pa can gyi pags pa la sogs pa'i steng du 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma'i go rim bzhin phab la 'gro phyogs su kha bsgyur te phud kyis bran te bzhag

sgrub pa po rnams langs te dgra phyogs su kha bltas la rnga rol dang bcas pas mgon po lcam dral bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyan sngar rang rang gi /srog gi snying po phul nas dam bcas pa// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das srung ba'i tshogs// kun gyi gtso bo dpal ldan nag po che// lcam bral bran g.yog bka' sdod 'khor dang bcas// rnam 'phrul du mas hūm̐ phaṭa sgra sgrogs shing*/ ha ha'i gad rgyangs srid gsum g.yo bar mdzad// ro ru ro zhes gdug pa'i khrag rgyun gsol// mā ra'i sgra 'byin gsod la brtson rnams kyis// bstan pa srung dang 'gro la phan gdags phyir// bstan la gnod byed gdug pa'i tshogs rnams kun// dam bcas de bzhin myur du mngon par khug /gṛh+ṇa ban+dhas bzung zhing bcings nas ni// ha na da has bsnun cing sdigs par mdzad// pa tsa pa tsas bsregs bcad gtubs nas ni// mā ra mā ras myur du bsgral ba yi// sha khrag las grub mchod gtor rgya chen 'di// kha kha khā his legs par bstab pa yis// rang gi sha gcod brtul zhugs bzlog nas ni// dam nyams snying khrag dbugs la myur du rol// gzhan la 'khu byed gtor ma'i las rtsom gyi// kha 'jam sems sdug rang gi phyogs 'dzin cing*// bu ltar bcos pa'i gsad pa'i dgra bo 'di// myur du tshar gcod bdag don yongs rdzogs mdzod// ces dang*/ gdong bzhi pa'i drag bskul ni/ hūm̐ chos skyong stobs 'phrog nag po da tshur gson// srung ma bram ze'i gzugs can da tshur gson// sha za sring mo bzhi po da tshur gson// lha chen nag po gdong bzhi lcam dral khyod// pha mes brgyud pa'i ring nas khyod bsten no// slob dpon brgyud dang bcas pas khyod bsten no// bdag gis gus pa'i tshul gyis khyod bsten no// gtor ma ri ltar spungs nas khyod sgrub bo// do nub khyod kyi thugs dam dus la babs// spyir gyi rgyal ba'i bstan pa bshig pa dang*// dpal ldan bla ma'i sku dgra byed pa dang*// sems can yongs la 'tshe ba byed pa sogs// bsgral ba'i zhing bcu nag po khyod kyis sgrol// sgrub bo bdag ni ma nyes gzur gnas kyang*// sdig can dgra bo'i nyes pa tshur la bsgos// mi la lha med lha la mthu med zer// bdag la mi min chos la chos min zer// yid la brnags pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs 'di// lo zla yun ring bzhag pa'i long med pas// da lta dngos su khug la bsgral bar mdzod// nga nyid ma nyes yus kyis brnang pa yis// srung ma khyed la rab mda' bos pa na// 'di la da ltar dngos su rtags phyung shig

/'di la da ltar rtags mtshan ma phyung na// khyod nyid mthu rtsal myur ba brdzun du nges// thog ser me dbal bcas pa 'di la rgyob// nad rigs bzhi brgya rtsa bzhi 'di la thong*// glo snying dmar po phyung la zhal du gsol// ltas ngan cho 'phrul mi rung sna tshogs ston// 'di yi sha rus zhal du chem chem gsol// snying khrag dron mo hub kyis 'thung bar gyis// mdor na rdul phran bzhin du brlag par mdzod// da res bcol ba'i las 'di ma bsgrubs na// khyod kyis thub pa'i spyan sngar khas blangs dang*// pha mes brgyud pa'i dam las 'gal bar 'gyur// de bas da res bdag gis bcol ba yi// phrin las srung ma khyod kyis grub par mdzod// ces dang*/ slar yang khro tshul dang bcas te/ hūm̐ dam can mon bu pu tra khyod// bka' yi las mkhan mthu rtsal can// dpa' bo bdud 'joms dgra srog gcod// khro gtum rngams pa khyod la bstod// ging chen nag po bha ṭa ni// mthing nag stag gi slog pa gyon// dam shing dgra bgegs snying la 'debs// sgrol byed bdud pho khyod la bstod// mon mo kha nas me 'bar ma// dam nyams sgrol ba'i mthu mo che// gtum chen 'jigs pa'i nga ro sgrogs// gsod byed nag mo khyod la bstod// kun kyang mi sdug cha byad can// phyag na mtshon cha sna tshogs 'dzin// rngams shing gsod pa'i las la brtson// 'khor dang bcas pa dgra la chos// dam can ming sring mthu rtsal can// da ni chos shig dmag la chos// dgra bo'i yul du dmag drongs la// dam nyams chom la phob la shog /khyod kyi g.yas kyi ru 'dren pa// skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya// btsan dang gshin rje'i dmag tshogs kyis// dmag sna drongs shig dgra la chos// khyod kyi g.yon gyi ru 'dren pa// dgra bcom 'khar gsil thogs pa brgya// rgyal po the'u rang dmag tshogs kyis// dmag sna drongs shig dgra la chos// khyod kyi slad nas rjes 'brang ba// sngags nag phur zor 'phen pa brgya// drag po gza' dang bdud dmag gis// dmag sna drongs shig dgra la chos// khyod kyi gshed kyi shul 'dren pa// bud med gri thod thogs pa brgya// sha za ma mo'i dmag tshogs kyis// dmag sna drongs shig dgra la chos// gzhan yang dam can 'khor gyi tshogs// mon pa pho mo a tsa ra// ma mo sha za sring mo sogs// thams cad mi sdug cha byad can// rngams shing gsod pa'i las la brtson// zhal nas 'jigs pa'i nga ro sgrogs// mchong zhing lding zhing rgyug 'dral byed// la las glo snying dmar po za// la las mi rkang gling bu 'bud// 'ga' zhig zhing chen g.yab mo 'debs// la las zhags pa nag po thogs// la las gsur chen dud pa btang*// 'di tsam tshad du ma nges te// las mkhan pho nya bsam mi khyab// 'ur 'ur chem chem stong gsum khengs// thams cad sdang ba'i dgra la 'gyed// chos shig chos shig dmag la chos// dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor// dgra bo'i yul du dmag drongs la// ltas ngan cho 'phrul de ru phob// nad kha rims kha dgra la bzlog

/'go ba'i lha dang phrol la shog /snying dang dbang po phyung la shog /mgo dang yan lag phrol la shog /rigs brgyud rtsad nas chod la shog /thal ba rdul du brlag par gyis// dus la bab po mthu ma chung*// dus la bab po rtsal ma zhan// bcol pa'i phrin las grub par mdzod// ces drag tu bskul bas mgon po 'khor bcas las byed pho nya sprul pa yang sprul rnams khros shing 'khrugs te dgra bo'i yul du chas par goms la/ dar nag dang gsur chen gyi dud pas sna drangs te/ skyes pa stag chas dang*/ dge slong dang*/ sngags nag dang*/ bud med kyi tshogs kyi ru 'dren rnams dang*/ sgrub pa po rnams kyis rnga dung rol mo dang slob dpon gyis gtor ma bteg la phyi rol du spyan drangs la sngar ltar bzhag thog mar thun gtor chu chang gis sbyangs la/ sngags dbyangs dang bcas pa'i spyi stabs bya ba ni/ hūm̐ dpal ldan mgon po ma hā kā la dang*// dpal ldan lha mo mi pham srid gsum bdag /rdo rje nag po chen po zhal bzhi pa// ma rungs las mdzad yum chen bzhi dang bcas// lcam dral khyod kyi bka' mi 'da' sogs dkyus ltar byas pa'i mthar/ shā sa na bzla ba dang bcas te/ thun gtor mgon po 'khor bcas la gla rngan gyi tshul du phul bas mnyes par bsams la/ kye bos so chos skyong snyan ma sra// g.yab po legs ldan spyan ma rtul// bsten no mgon po rgyang ma ring*// bsgrub bo mgon po dam ma g.yel// bskul lo nag po phrag ma dog /rbad do dam can mthu ma chung*// sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba'i phyir// dam la dgongs la gnas 'dir byon// byang chub bsgrub pa mthar phyin mdzod// chos skyong mgon po lcam dral la// gzhan yang phrin las bcol ba ni// rgyal ba'i bstan pa bshig pa dang*// dkon mchog dbu 'phang smad pa dang*// bdag cag sgrub pa byed pa la// bsam sbyor ngan pa byed pa rnams// gang yin nag po chen pos sgrol// zhes pas drag tu bskul la/

las kyi rdo rjes gser skyems nam mkhar gtor zhing*/ hūm̐ bdag lus rdo rje 'chang dpal gyi// sprul pa'i khro rgyal nyid kyi bka'// phyogs dang phyogs mtshams gnas pa yi// 'byung po'i tshogs rnams kun nyon cig /rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag rnams// dam tshig rgyan gyis mdzes byas shing*// rim gnyis ting 'dzin brtan byas te// bzlas brjod sngags kyi pha rol phyin// de phyir sngags 'chang 'od stong ldan// phrin las rnam bzhi mkha' la rgyu// dgra bgegs gting nas skem pa'i phyir// gtor zor drag po'i pho nya 'gyed// dbang po byin za gshin rje dang*// srin po chu bdag rlung lha dang*// nor lha dbang ldan la sogs pa// bdag gi grogs mdzod zor lam phye// zor 'phang phyogs dang nye ba na// yul lha'i rigs dang chu mig rdo// shing dang sa la gnas pa yi// 'byung po thams cad sku gzur cig /don gnyer gang zhig phyogs su 'gro// lam du zhugs dang mkha' la rgyu// dgra bgegs ma gtogs 'gro ba rnams// rang rang phyogs su sku gzur cig /gzur bar 'dod la bskyod ma nus// brtan par gnas pa'i sa bdag sogs// ma 'jigs ko lang ma sdom par// mtho bar gnas pa zhabs brdogs la// dma' bar gnas pa dbu chum cig /bar snang gnas pa bsgrims nas su// na bza'i mtha' dang zhabs bskums shig /srid gsum gzhom par 'dod pa yi// mthu stobs drag po'i shugs 'chang 'di// dam nyams dgra bo'i snying la 'phang*// ma rungs dam nyams dgra bo 'dis// dam tshig rdo rje'i rwa ba bshig /sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams par byas// dam chos sgrub pa'i bar du bcad// skye 'gro yongs kyi bde ba bcom// rig 'dzin sgrub ba'i thugs dkrugs shing*// dpal ldan bla ma'i dgrar gyur 'di// sha khrag rus pa'i tshogs gtor nas// snying khrag zhal du gsol bar mdzod// slar yang dgra'i yul mthong ba'i sa'am mthun pa'i rlung rgyu sar phyin la/

der srung mas 'jig rten khams thams cad gang bar bsams la/ phrin las bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ lha chen dpal 'bar mthu ma chung*// zhes sogs bzlog bskul dang*/ spro na/ 'dir bla ma gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i zhal bzhi pa 'khor tshogs bcas bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ legs ldan nag po'i las byed pho nya'i tshogs// rnal 'byor bdag gi dgra la rbad pa'i tshe// dam nyams dgra srog myur du gcod pa'i dus// dmar mo khrag 'dzag zhal du khrag rgyun gsol// nag po'i las byed nyams pa'i sha la gsol// rgyal chen bzhi yi ru mtshon pu ru ru// phyogs skyong bcu ni nam mkha'i sprin ltar gtibs// nag po stong gi las byed khyug se khyug /sha za'i tshogs rnams rkan sgra tog se tog /ma mo mkha' 'gro'i gdung dbyangs kyu ru ru// lha srin sde brgyad 'bod sgra di ri ri// bdud dang srin po'i dung 'bud lhang nge lhang*// stag spyang seng ge'i ngar sgra 'ur ru ru// bzhad dang kang ka'i kha spu spungs se spungs// gtum chen dur bya'i gshog sgra 'u ru ru// bya rog khwa ta mang po thibs se thib// rnal 'byor bdag la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams// rdo rje srin po 'khor bcas rnams la gtad// bdag la sdang ba'i dam nyams dgra bo 'di// lo dang zla bar bzhag pa'i long med pas// zhag dang za mar ma bzhag da sod cig /dgra bgegs 'byung po 'khor bcas shor ra re// shan pa'i tshogs rnams myur du las la rgyug /bdag la bsam pa ngan pa'i dgra bgegs 'di// lus ngag yid gsum thal ba rdul du rlog /ltas ngan sna tshogs de yi thad du phob// chag che nyam nga de yi steng du bzlog /ces dang*/ pho nya bskul ba ni/ hūm̐ bh+yo dpal 'bar ma hā kā la dang*// lha chen dpal 'bar mthu chen gyis// steng nas sprul pa'i pho nya ni// khyung chen sngon po lding zhing 'khor// bh+yo bh+yo de ni dgra la bh+yo// chos chos de ni dmag la chos// dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor// dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog

/dpal 'bar ma hā kā la dang*// lha chen dpal 'bar mthu chen gyis// g.yas nas sprul pa'i pho nya ni// bya nag mang po 'phur zhing lding*// bh+yo bh+yo de ni dgra la bh+yo// chos chos de ni dmag la chos// dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor// dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /dpal 'bar ma hā kā la dang*// lha chen dpal 'bar mthu chen gyis// g.yon nas sprul pa'i pho nya ni// khyi nag mang po 'khang zhing zug /bh+yo bh+yo de ni dgra la bh+yo// chos chos de ni dmag la chos// dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor// dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /dpal 'bar ma hā kā la dang*// lha chen dpal 'bar mthu chen gyis// rgyab nas sprul pa'i pho nya ni// ce spyang sngon po mdur zhing rgyug /bh+yo bh+yo de ni dgra la bh+yo// chos chos de ni dmag la chos// dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor// dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /dpal 'bar ma hā kā la dang*// lha chen dpal 'bar mthu chen gyis// mdun nas sprul pa'i pho nya ni// mi nag gnam du 'o dod 'bod// bh+yo bh+yo de ni dgra la bh+yo// chos chos de ni dmag la chos// dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor// dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /gaṇ+ḍe las sprul pho nya ni// khro chen 'bar bas 'jig rten 'gengs// mngags shing las la bskul ba'i tshe// stong gsum 'jig rten ma lus gang*// hūm̐ dang phaṭa kyi sgra sgrogs shing*// la la ba dan g.yab mo g.yob// la la mi rkang gling bu 'bud// kha cig rgyu ma'i zhags pa 'phen// la la dmar chen rak+ta sprengs// la la tshil chen dud pa gtul// la la gnam lcags thog ser 'bebs// la la zhing chen g.yab mo g.yob// bh+yo bh+yo de ni dgra la bh+yo// chos chos de ni dmag la chos// dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor// dgra bgegs thal ba rdul du rlog /hūm̐ bh+yo las kyi mgon po'i pho nya ni// g.yas nas ru 'dren dpa' rtsal can// skyes pa stag chas brgyan pa brgya// g.yon nas ru 'dren sprul pa'i sku// nyan thos dge slong dgra bcom brgya// slad nas rjes 'brang 'jigs rung ba// ban+de nag po phur thogs brgya// mdun nas shul 'dren drag shul can// bud med gri thod thogs pa brgya// bh+yo bh+yo de ni dgra la bh+yo// chos chos de ni dmag la chos// dmag dpung bskyed la ru mtshon phyor// dgra gegs thal ba rdul du rlog

/ces pas bskul lo// de nas slob dpon gyis phud mchod bya ba ni/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs sogs nas/ drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma che ge mo pa'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ mkha' 'gro rdo rje gur/ slob dpon bram ze mchog sred/ paṇa chen bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrad+dha ka ra warma/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge /rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas seng ge /brang ti nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ shar chen byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub shākya kun dga'/ mkhas btsun kun dga' legs pa/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub/ de nyid las bdag gis sam/ yang na/ sangs rgyas phun tshogs nas/ mtshungs med bsod nams dpal ldan/ mkhan chen dpal ldan chos skyong*/ de nyid las bdag gis thob pa sogs rang gis thob yul gyi bla ma gang yin yan chad sbrel te/ brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang dbang bskur sogs 'dra ba las/ chos skyong gi skabs su/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la ya/ ma hā kā li de w+yai/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā la tsa turmu khā sa pa ri wā ra ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang chos 'khor srung zhing sogs nas rang gis myang ba'i bar spyi ltar brjod/ de nas slob dpon gyi ngag tu/

chos rje sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i dmod bskul/ hūm̐ stobs ldan ma hā kā la/ khrag 'thung gi rgyal po/ ye shes gsal ba'i spyan dang ldan pa/ rdzu 'phrul myur ba'i zhabs dang ldan pa/ nag po stong gi 'khor gyis bskor ba/ sha za 'bum gyis 'khor gyis bskor ba/ ma mo bye ba'i 'khor gyis bskor ba/ dam nyams kun gyi srog gcod/ rig 'dzin kun gyi srog shing*/ gtsug lag khang gi srung ma/ dug gsum nad kyi sman pa/ 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis/ rdo rje 'chang bram ze mchog sred/ rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras brgyud par bcas pa/ bdag cag gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i bar du byon pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma rnams kyi bka' dang dam las ma 'da' bar/ rnal 'byor pa bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i srung ma mdzad nas/ bstan pa la sdang ba'i dgra/ gnod pa'i bgegs thams cad skad cig tsam gyis myur du sgrol la/ rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su drongs shig /mthu ma chung*/ rtsal ma zhan/ rnal 'byor pa bdag gis bcol pa'i phrin las thams cad grub par mdzod cig ces pa'am/ rang phyogs su sngar srol gang yod kyi dmod bskul tshad ldan yod na des kyang rung ste/ gang ltar yang bstan srung rnams la las bskul gyi tshig drag tu brjod cing*/ sgrub grogs rnams kyis rbad bsad kyi sngags bzla zhing drag rol rgyun ring bar bya'o// rdo rje zor 'dzin gyis 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma nas rim par thogs te/ gtor mgron srung ma rnams kyis gtor ma zos pas tshim par gyur nas/ de dag gi mthu stobs rab tu rgyas/ zos pa'i lhag ma rnams dug gi sdong bu dang ral gri dang mdung thung la sogs pa'i mtshon cha phur bu dang dam shing dang gri gug me 'bar ba la sogs pa rnams su gyur pa/ las kyi mgon po la sogs pa rnams kyis bzung ste/ sgrub pa po dang lhan cig tu dgra bgegs rnams stobs gzhom pa'i phyir/ khro 'khrugs rngams pa'i nyams dang*/

mthu stobs nus pa dpag tu med pa'i gzi brjid cher rgyas pa'i sprul pa yang sprul pho nya'i tshogs 'jig rten khams khyab pa rnams dang*/ khyad par mgon po'i g.yas phyogs nas bya nag dang*/ steng nas khyung chen gyi tshogs spros/ bstan pa dang bstan 'dzin dang rnal 'byor pa la gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs dmigs yul sa bla'i gnas nas bkug de bzhin du g.yon dang rgyab nas khyi nag dang lce spyang gi tshogs spros/ sa 'og nas gdug pa can rnams bkug mdun phyogs nas mi nag 'jig rten khams gang ba spros/ sa stengs nas gdug pa can rnams bkug nas gtor ma gang du brgyab pa'i sa der gnam lcags las grub pa'i dong gru gsum me 'bar bar bsams la/ der pho nya rnams kyis gdug pa can de yan lag lcags sgrog dang zhags pas bsdams te bzhag de la bstan dgra gnod byed gdug pa can gzhan dag kyang bkug la bstim/ de rnams kyi stobs dang las ngan gsog pa'i lus rten rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo/ a thung rten dang bcas pa'i steng du gtor ma rnams brgyab pas/ srung ma rnams dang lhan cig pas gnod gnas de nyid du gnam lcags kyi thog phog pa ltar thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du bcom/ slar chos gos kyi sne mos kyang brdab pa lan gsum byas la/ chos skyong srung ma rnams kyis dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus pa rnams bzhes nas rjes med du btang bar bsams la/ sngags ring shib bus bzlas shing*/ kho'i rgyud kyi gnod sems sbyor rtsub thams cad 'od gsal bde ba chen po'i ngang du zhig ste/ rang sems dang bsres la lta ba 'dzin med kyi ngang du ci gnas su 'jog de nas phyi mig mi blta bar srung 'khor yang gsal gdab ste tshur log go /gsum pa rjes ni/ tshogs kyi 'khor lor rol pa dang*/ rdo rje'i glu bsngo ba smon lam byas la/ rgyun gtor 'bul ba dang*/ yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskang ba/ bzod par gsol zhing sku gzugs kyi rten yod pa rnams la brtan bzhugs dang*/

rten med pa'i gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas dam tshig pa rang la bsdus nas skye mched sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams gsal btab nas/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas sogs kyis smon lam gdab cing bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// 'dir smras pa/ mthu chen bka' srung 'gro ba'i sgron ma yis// bdud dgra'i tshogs la mi bzad mun ster ba// las 'di rigs sam sngar nyid bar med las// lan 'gar bsags pa bsgral bya rang gi skyon// bstan pa de 'dzin bcas la gnod byas kyi// lan du mngon spyod las kyis mnar 'gyur ba// mkha' dbyings mi gtsang gis gtor de ni de'i// thad du ltung las gzhan pa gang du 'gro// rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pas bstan srung tshogs// rbad bskul brtsams pa'i g.yar lam bstan dgra yi// srog rtsa rdo rjer grub kyang skad cig ma// gnyis par gson nam ma yin 'phyang mo nyug /spros che lha lam pha rol 'dom 'jal dang*// bsdus mtha' khab mig mdzub 'tshang ma byas par// rno rtul bar ma'i blor 'tsham gtor bzlog brtan// mngon spyod grong khyer 'jug pa'i sgo 'phar phyes// gang phyir brjod bya snying pos ches brling ba// rjod byed tshogs gsum phreng dngar ma byas pa// lag blang brgyud pa'i thugs kar yibs pa bcas// rnam gsal yi ge bzhad pa'i nga ro bsgrags// dge ba 'di yis mkhas pa'i las gsum gyis// khams gsum rmongs pa 'phrog byed sa skya pa'i// tshul chen mkhas grub kun gyi 'byung gnas mchog /bskal pa ji srid gnas par rgyas gyur cig /thabs shes yi ges mtshan bstan skyong byed pa'i// smra mkhas dge 'dun 'dus tshogs dmar mdangs kyis// phyogs bral brtan ma'i dkyil 'khor yongs bkab pas// chos spyod rnam bcu'i bgyi ba gong 'phel shog /ces bstan srung dbang po rnams thugs dgyes par bskyed pa dang*/ dgra bgegs la rbad pa'i tshul du sgrub pa'i phrin las gtor bzlog g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i nga ro zhes bya ba 'di ni/

sa dkar bsam 'grub dgon gyi dbu mdzad rnam par dpyod ldan shākya bzang pos bskul ba'i ngor/ dgon der sngar nas mgon po che chung du grags pa 'khor bcas kyi bskang ba thun mong dang thun mong min pa zhag grangs su 'don srol mchis mod/ mjug tu gtor ma la dgra bgegs dgug gzhug tsam byas mthar/ pho nya bskul nas dmod bachol tsam byed pa la gtor rdzong du btags pa zhig las ma byung bar/ tshul 'di ko rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab chen po rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i man ngag g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i bzhed par/ dgra bgegs la rbad pa'i tshul du sgrub pa nyid gtso bor bzung nas cung zad kha 'gengs 'os pa'i rigs kyi zhabs 'degs dang bcas te nyams su blang bde bar/ sngags spyod 'chang gi ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ dpal lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi ba gam gsum par sbyar ba sarba maṅga laṃ bha wan+tu// // ༄༅// gtor bzlog skabs kyi dmod bskul bstan srung dgra la 'gyed pa'i 'jigs rung bzhad sgra zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ bstan pa bstan 'dzin skyong bar zhal 'ches pa'i// bstan srung dam tshig ldan pas bskul tsam gyis// bstan dgra dam nyams bsgral la ches rngam pa'i// bstan srung las la 'gyed pa'i nga ro bsgrags// de'ang 'dir gtor bzlog skabs su rnal 'byor pas bstan don snying phugs su bcug pa'i/ mngon spyod las kyi phrin las su bcol ba na/ 'di skad du/ ho dgongs su gsol lo// lan gsum/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang*/ mkha' 'gro rdo rje gur/ bram ze mchog sred/ nor bu gling ba bde ba'i rdo rje/ shrad+dha ka ra warma/ jo bo rin chen bzang po/ brag steng pa yon tan tshul khrims/ bla ma mal jo lo tsā ba dang*/ rdo rje 'chang*/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ ba liṃ ta pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal bde ba'i zhabs/ dri med sbas pa/

rin chen grags pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyan lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ gnam kha'u pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gdams pa kun gyi bka' babs dpal sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams seng ge yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel ba/ sa lo thams cad mkhyen pa/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge brang ti paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ shar chen kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub shākya kun dga'/ mkhas btsun kun dga' legs pa/ rje dam chos bsam 'grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mkhan chen bkra shis lhun grub/ yang na/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mtshungs med bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ mkhan chen byams pa bsod nams bzang po/ gang rung rang rang gi thob yul gyi brgyud pa dang 'brel mar brjod/ zhes brgyud pa rgyas pa ltar na de ltar brjod/ mi nus na gong gi rje btsun sa skya pa chen po zhes pa man chad dam/ yang na kun dga' bzang po nas/ bdag cag gi yongs 'dzin 'khor lo'i mgon po'i bar gyi dbang bskur byin rlabs sogs dang sbrel te brjod kyang chog go /gzhan yang dbang bskur byin rlabs gdams ngag gi bka' srol rim par brgyud pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa de rnams kyis bstan pa bsrung zhing bstan 'dzin skyong bar bka' bsgos shing dam la bzhag pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan srung chen po/ dpal ldan ma hā ka la/ khrag 'thung gi rgyal po ye shes gsal ba'i spyan dang ldan pa/

rdzu 'phrul myur ba'i zhabs dang ldan pa/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po/ dpal ldan gur gyi mgon po/ sku mdog dus mtha'i sprin ltar gnag pa/ nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ spyan nas me'i tsha tsha 'phro ba/ shangs nas me rlung rab tu 'tshubs pa/ zhal nas 'jigs pa'i nga ro sgrogs pa/ g.yas nas bya nag 'bum sdes gshog skor byed pa/ g.yon nas khyi nag 'bum sde 'khang zhing zug pa/ rgyab nas lcags sbyangs 'bum sde 'dur zhing rgyug pa/ mdun nas mi nag 'bum sdes dgra la 'o dod 'bod pa/ steng na khyung chen 'bum sde lding ba/ pho nya sprul pa yang sprul dang bcas pa rnams dang*/ sku'i mgon po/ gsung gi mgon po/ thugs kyi mgon po/ yon tan gyi mgon po/ phrin las kyi mgon po/ nag po stong gi 'khor dang ldan pa/ sha za 'bum gyi 'khor dang ldan pa/ ma mo bye ba'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams snyan gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo// gzhan yang dpal ldan lha mo 'dod pa khams kyi dbang phyug ma/ stong gsum yud tsam gyis bskor ba/ rdzu 'phrul glog ltar myur ba/ mthu stobs thog ltar che ba/ ye shes kyi sbyin dang ldan pa 'khor ma mo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs/ 'khor gnod sbyin sha la dga' ba dung phyur/ ma mo khrag la dga' ba bye ba dung phyur/ dri za gsur la dga' ba bye ba 'bum sde'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams snyan gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo// lha mchog ma hā ka la/ lha chen gdong bzhi gnyan po// zhing skyong gzi ldan dbang phyug bram ze'i gzugs can dpa' bo/ yum chen g.yung mo nag mo/ las mdzad gtum mo ljang gu/ ser nag siṃ ga li ma/ dmar nag srin mo chen mo/ gnod sbyin dregs pa lcam sring*/ 'khor dregs pa sde brgyad kyi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams snyan gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo// gzhan yang las byed kyi mgon po las la rngam pa/ khro la gtum pa/ skye 'gro'i srog bdag chen po ber nag zangs gri can/

bran bdud gshin rje nag po/ mi sdug gnod sbyin yab yum/ mgon po ma ning nag po la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srung bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dpal mgon dam tshig can rnams snyan gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo// phyogs skyong ba bcu/ lha chen po brgyad/ klu chen po brgyad/ gza' chen po brgyad/ rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad/ 'jigs byed chen po dgu/ rgyal po chen po sde bzhi ste dpal gtsang ris kyi mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga/ 'jig rten gyi dregs byed bka' lha ma srin sde brgyad/ yul phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i zo dor sa bdag gzhi bdag mthu bo che 'khor dang bcas pa rnams snyan gsan cing dgongs su gsol lo// khyed rnams la rnal 'byor dam tshig ldan pa bdag gi dgra bo'i phrin las bcol zhing las la bskul ba ni/ spyir yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po/ 'gro 'dul kha lo sgyur ba/ nyag gcig skyabs kyi dam pa/ bcom ldan 'das shākya seng ge'i bstan pa rin po che la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa rnams dang*/ bye brag tu/ dus gsum sangs rgyas 'dus pa'i rang bzhin/ rigs gsum sems dpa' chen po'i sgyu 'phrul/ theg gsum bstan pa smra ba'i seng ge khams gsum srid mtsho las sgrol ded dpon chen po/ dpal sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po zhes yongs su grags pa yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i bstan pa rin po che dar rgyas su byed pa la bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs rnams dang*/ thub mchog lung zin skyes bu dam pa/ rtsod ldan dus kyi thams cad mkhyen pa/ rgyal bstan ring por 'tsho ba'i sman pa/ gsung rab dgongs pa 'grel pa'i nyi ma/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po pa'i lugs mchog dri ma med pa'i phrin las dang*/ de 'dzin gyi skyes bu dam par bcas pa'i sku tshe 'gro don dang bcas pa la rnam par 'tshe zhing bar du gcod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs rnams dang*/

snyigs dus skye dgu'i gtsug gi nor bu/ mkhyen brtse'i 'od stong 'bar ba'i snang byed/ bstan 'gro'i dge legs 'gugs pa'i pho nya/ phrin las kun du khyab pa'i bdud rtsi'i 'od can/ dpal sa skya pa'i gdung sras kyi phreng ba rim par byon cing da ltar 'tsho gzhes su bzhugs pa rnams kyi sku tshe/ phrin las/ mnga' thang dpal 'byor bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs rnams dang*/ lung rtogs bstan pa rgyas pa'i rtsa lag bshad sgrub sgra dbyangs 'byin pa'i rnga gsang*/ sbyin pa dag pa'i yon gnas dam pa/ ngur smrig 'chang ba 'dus pa'i chos grwa chen po/ che ge mo zhes bya bas mtshon pa'i rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po'i ring lugs dri ma med pa'i rjes su slob cing bshad sgrub kyi bya ba la brtson pa'i chos sde mtha' dag gi phrin las/ mnga' thang*/ dpal 'byor/ grwa rigs/ mi sder bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dam nyams dgra bgegs rnams dang*/ rgyal ba'i myu gu dam pa/ rgyal bstan skyong ba'i rtsa lag dad dang gtong ba'i nor can/ zla bral bstan pa'i sbyin bdag dpal sde dge sa skyong chen po'i gdung brgyud mu tig bstar la brgyus pa lta bur rgyun mi chad par byon pa rnams kyi sku tshe/ phrin las/ chab srid/ mnga' thang bcas pa la gnod cing 'tshe bar byed pa'i dgra bgegs zhes pa'am/ sbyin bdag phal pa yin na de lugs dang mthun par brjod/ gsang chen rig pa 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ bdag cag sgrub pa po yon sbyor 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang*/ bsam pa ngan pa dang*/ sbyor ba rtsub mor brtsams shing brtsam par 'gyur ba'i dgra bgegs log 'dren byad ma'i rigs su gyur pa gang yin pa dang*/ mdor na sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i bstan dgra/ dkon mchog gsum gyi spyi dgra/
